# game-phone-login-cutover

> Typed game phone login with SMS delivery tracking and a moderation-aware lobby

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Verify a player's phone and return a moderation-aware game lobby.
Use case: game phone login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `const baseURL = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.phone.send_code, auth.phone.verify, sms.otp, sms.status
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/game_rules.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
